_comment: Vendor symlinks under public/js/ that point into node_modules.
Keys are the link name; values are the link target, relative to public/js/.
Generated and verified by scripts/link-vendor.js and
scripts/check-vendor-links.js. npm run link:vendor recreates them;
npm run check:links fails if any dangle, point at an undeclared
dependency, or exist without a manifest entry.
Adding a frontend library here is one of three options -- see
PLAN-vendor-link-robustness.md. Libraries loaded lazily or lacking an AMD
